scope: Private monster curse handler. Its carried-item fallback changes exactly one eligible record. Existing static equipped-item/refusal notices use the audited queue mapping. Ordinary monster AI acquisition and other curse callers remain separate.

entries.review: Dedicated Japanese/native-context review: preserve the named attacker and curse effect. Native2B918 prioritizes one equipped shield, weapon or ring, then curses only the first eligible carried item; the270 fallback therefore says an item, not all possessions. Complete actor field and conditional line break preserve width/byte budgets.
